description: Retire the freeform scripts/cam/progress.txt. It stacks three different lifecycles in one file: durable Codebase Patterns (a), an ephemeral per-story record scraped as markdown by the dashboard (b), and a handoff duplicate in Notes (c). Separate by lifecycle: (b) becomes the structured event log .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl (already the canonical per-story record since CAM-22 US-013, already gitignored) and the dashboard reads it instead of scraping markdown; (a) moves to a durable versioned doc (scripts/cam/patterns.md), never truncated; (c) is already handoff.json, stop duplicating. RELATES: CAM-22 (event log foundation), CAM-27 (leak), CAM-28 (dashboard liveness).
docsConsultedRationale: No external library touched: an internal dashboard reader swap (jsonl over markdown), a doc migration, and agent/slash instruction edits. No npm API exercised.

userStories.title: Dashboard reads the structured event log instead of scraping progress.txt
userStories.description: As an operator watching the dashboard, I want the Recent panel to be sourced from the structured event log (real timestamps, structured outcome) rather than scraping markdown headings out of progress.txt.
acceptanceCriteria: src/commands/dashboard.ts's recent-entries source changes from scripts/cam/progress.txt to the event log at .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl.

A new pure parser (replacing parseRecentProgress) reads the jsonl, takes the last N 'result' events, and renders one single-line summary each (e.g. '<ts-short> US-XXX <outcome>'), newest first; it is exported for tests like parseRecentProgress was.
Missing or empty event-log file yields an empty list (no crash); a malformed jsonl line is skipped, not fatal.
The Recent panel empty-state text no longer says 'progress.txt' in BOTH the print path (src/commands/dashboard.ts) and the Ink path (src/ui/Dashboard.tsx); use e.g. '(no activity yet)'.

Existing dashboard tests are updated: the progress.txt-scraping tests for parseRecentProgress are replaced with event-log-parsing tests (fixtures of result/tokens/worker-start lines); the dashboard composition test still passes.

readRecentProgress / parseRecentProgress and the PROGRESS_PATH constant are removed if fully replaced (grep returns no dead CODE references). The src/supervisor/events.ts header comments at ~11 and ~106 that reference the planned progress.txt retirement (CAM-31) are refreshed to past tense or removed, since the retirement is now done.
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/dashboard.ts (readRecentProgress ~517, parseRecentProgress ~535, PROGRESS_PATH ~47, the Recent panel render ~268-282, the DashboardData.recent field ~163, runDashboard's read at ~370), test/dashboard*.test.ts. The event log line shape is one JSON object per line with { ts, storyId, uuid, kind, detail }; a 'result' event has detail { outcome, filesChanged, gates, docsValidated } (src/supervisor/events.ts buildResultDetail). Filter kind==='result' for the per-story summary; ts is an ISO string. The file is .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl (already gitignored). Keep DashboardData.recent: string[] to minimize churn; only the source + parser change. ALSO src/ui/Dashboard.tsx (the Ink RecentSection empty-state copy at ~347 says '(no progress.txt entries yet)'; update it to match). The Ink dashboard receives DashboardData; only the empty-state string + any 'progress' label need updating there, the data still flows through DashboardData.recent.

userStories.title: Retire progress.txt across the agent and slash-command instructions, re-embed
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want every workflow instruction to stop creating or appending to the freeform progress.txt and to point at the event log (factual record) + patterns.md (durable wisdom) + handoff.json (handoff) instead.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md: the 'Progress Report Format' + 'Codebase Patterns Block' sections are rewritten to: the per-story factual record is the event log (.claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, written by the harness, not the agent), reusable patterns go to scripts/cam/patterns.md, and handoff context goes to handoff.json. The agent no longer appends to progress.txt. The 'Your Task' step that says 'Append your progress to progress.txt' is removed or repointed.

.claude/commands/cam-plan.md, cam-review.md, cam-ship.md and their templates/ copies no longer write/create progress.txt: cam-plan stops creating progress.txt at branch time; cam-review.md Step 5.3 and 5.4 SIMPLY DROP the 'Append to scripts/cam/progress.txt' blocks (the prd.json.review block + the operator print already record the round; the event log is supervisor-owned and not LLM-writable from the slash), and Step 5.6's 'mutates prd.json + progress.txt' wording drops progress.txt; cam-ship's harness-reset git rm keeps the tolerant 2>/dev/null form for old branches.

.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md, subagent-reviewer.md, subagent-auditor.md AND their templates/agents/ copies no longer reference appending to progress.txt; any 'progress.txt' mention is repointed to the event log / patterns.md / handoff.json.
docs/recovery-runbook.md is checked: any 'progress.txt' reference is updated to the new sources.
bun run embed-vendor regenerated and bun run embed-vendor:check passes (templates changed).
grep -rn 'progress.txt' across .claude/, templates/, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, docs/ returns only intentional historical mentions (e.g. a 'retired' note), not live write instructions.
No em-dash in any edited persisted .md.
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
